Guarantor admission is insurance: no new identity enters alone. An established agent locks 200 for 15 epochs; the newcomer stakes 100.

The anchor holds both ways: forgery forfeits the newcomer's stake and 50% of the guarantor's, plus its vouching right for 10 epochs. Proving fraud earns the challenger 20.

An island of 1,000 fakes needs 500 guarantors sharing 100,000; 30% detection costs the ring 45,000. No glacier of fakes passes unpaid.
